SUCCESSION (KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act further to amend the Succession Act, 1925
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
17th October, 2019]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-64 / 2019/9715, dated 17.10.2019.---The Succession (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment)
Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 4th October, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 10th October, 2019 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Succession Act, 1925 (Act No. XXXIX of
1925) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Succession (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) (Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Insertion of new section to Act No.XXXIX of 1925

Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 4th October, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 10th October, 2019 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Succession Act, 1925 (Act No. XXXIX of
1925) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Insertion
of new section to Act No.XXXIX of 1925.---In the Succession Act, 1925 (Act No.XXXIX of 1925) after section 371,
the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"371-A.
Issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificate by National
Database Registration Authority.---For the purpose of this Act, the
National Database Registration Authority (NADRA), in accordance with the Family
Registration Certificate maintained by it, may issue letters of administration
and succession certificate to the legal heirs of a deceased, in accordance with
such procedure as may be provided in the National Database and Registration
Authority Ordinance, 2000 (Ordinance No. VIII of 2000) and the rules made thereunder
and any such letters of administration and succession certificate issued by the
National Database Registration Authority (NADRA) shall be deemed to be validly
issued under the provisions of this Act.".
